_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-35 base rate on ±2 point moves makes HOLD the statistically honest call — the coil has not broken and neither brain has produced a confirmed breaker signal, so sitting at Denial with a potential drift toward Disbelief on the next leg up is the disciplined read.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both see Denial and a risk-on regime, but the analyst explicitly hedges with low conviction and demands ETF flow confirmation while the narrative leans more confidently on the 77% structural analog without addressing the 0% breakout rate.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows sustain above 90 AND btc_momentum_30d holds above 50 for 2+ 12h windows, pushing score into the 39-46 Anxiety band or lifting phase to Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows drop below 70 OR mvrv_zscore falls further below 20, extending Denial downward toward Panic
